description:
The videos in the shared index nearest one of your finds (find_id from a Packaging or
    Long form run), nearest first, never the find's own video. Each has distance (0 is the
    same; measures says how it is computed), its numbers and its multiple over its
    channel's median. A find not indexed yet is matched by its own words (matched_from).
    Free. Same as GET /v1/finds/{find_id}/similar. Errors: 404 find_not_found.

type.description: video (default): by the title's meaning on any channel; title: on other channels; thumbnail: by our read of the picture on other channels
